evals.prompt: I ran CNVkit on a tumor sample (hg38) and have the segments in segments.tsv (columns: chromosome, start, end, log2, probes). Make a karyogram with gains (log2 > 0.3) painted red and losses (log2 < -0.3) painted blue on the chromosomes, two rows, with a legend. Save it as cnv_karyogram.png.
evals.expected_output: A two-group hg38 karyogram with gain and loss segments painted on the bodies, a legend, and a note about the chrUn and chrM rows that cannot be drawn.

evals.prompt: Manhattan plot please. gwas.tsv has CHR, BP, P from plink on hg19. CHR is numeric 1-23 (23 is X). I want a strip of the chromosome ideograms above the plot lined up with it, a genome-wide significance line, and chromosome names on the x axis. Save manhattan.png.
evals.expected_output: A Manhattan plot on concatenated hg19 coordinates with chromosome 23 mapped to X so its hits show, an aligned genome strip above, a 5e-8 line and chromosome tick labels.

evals.prompt: Make a vertical hg38 karyotype figure in two rows for a talk. density.tsv has gene counts in 1 Mb bins (chrom, start, end, count) and genes.tsv has cancer genes (chrom, start, symbol, class where class is oncogene or tsg). Show density as a filled area on one side of each chromosome, and mark and label the genes on the other side, colored by class with a legend. Save karyotype_genes.png.
evals.expected_output: A two-group vertical karyogram with a density area track on one side and a mark plus label track on the other, colored by class, with readable labels and a legend.
